title: Lab · Pipeline
description: A firmware rollout as rollout.py run reports it: the run, the verdict, host counts, gates and wave progress, every host's evidence step by step, checks and recovery, the decision log; then one host's events, the timeline and timing, errors

panels.title: Run
panels.description: The latest stage's start: the site, the component, the target and the update's OperationApplyTime, OnReset: the image waits for the rollout's own reset

panels.title: Elapsed
panels.description: From each stage's first event to its last, the stages added up

panels.title: Last event
panels.description: How fresh this is: a running pipeline writes an event every few seconds

panels.title: Result
panels.description: HALTED: a gate stopped the pipeline. RUNNING: a stage runs. PASSED: every gate passed

panels.title: How it ended: the latest stage
panels.description: A gate's decision in words: which wave, how many of its hosts failed. The hosts that need a person, with their next step, are in Host evidence below

targets.expr: {job="rollout",site="$site"} | json | pipeline="$pipeline" | step="run" | state="end" | line_format "{{.stage}} stage: {{.detail}}"

defaults.noValue: No stage end in Loki: still running, or it ran before Loki

panels.title: Updated and verified
panels.description: The target runs and the post-check passed

panels.title: Rolled back · failed
panels.description: Rolled back: the post-check failed, the version before is back and verified. Failed: the update failed before the reset, the old firmware still runs

panels.title: Needs a person · blocked
panels.description: Needs attention: no verified outcome, left drained. Blocked: pre-flight refused it

panels.title: Running · not started
panels.description: Not started: its wave hasn't run, or a gate halted before it, the waves of a halted canary too

panels.title: Still drained
panels.description: Hosts out of service: drained for a reset and not given back. A BMC update drains nothing

panels.title: Plan: the policy it used
panels.description: The plan stage reads every BMC live, pre-flights it, and puts the hosts that pass into the canary and waves by the site's rollout.yaml: this policy. Every later stage runs this plan

defaults.noValue: No plan in Loki for this pipeline

panels.title: Plan: every host's pre-flight, its wave, and how it would be rolled back
panels.description: The plan's pre-flight verdict per host: go, into the canary or a wave; skip, nothing to do now; block, a person has to look, with the reasons. Then how its component's update activates, which reset and whether the host restarts (then it is drained first), and the rollback the rollout carries out if the post-check fails: a reinstall of the version it runs now, from the catalog's package. none: no way back, so pre-flight blocks it unless --accept-no-rollback

targets.expr: {job="rollout",site="$site"} | json | pipeline="$pipeline" | step="plan" | host!="-" | label_format rollback=`{{regexReplaceAll "^reinstall .* from (images/)?" .rollback "reinstall "}}`

value.title: Its every event in this run

panels.title: Gates: the canary, then each wave
panels.description: The canary and the strict waves halt on any failure; a later wave over its halt_at; a host that failed its soak halts any wave

panels.title: Wave progress
panels.description: Every host of each wave by how it ended or where it is; the canary first

panels.title: Host evidence: each host, step by step
panels.description: One row per host of the plan, canary first: its versions before and after, then each step's outcome with its detail (the update's last Task message, how long the reset took, a check that failed), and how it ended. A host's link opens its every event, or its own dashboard

targets.expr: {job="rollout",site="$site"} | json | pipeline="$pipeline" | host!="-" | step!="pre-flight check" | state!="start" | state!="task" | json reasons_text="reasons" | line_format "{{.state}}{{if .detail}}{{if eq .step \"update\" \"rollback update\" \"reset\" \"rollback reset\"}} · {{regexReplaceAll \"TaskEvent.1.0.|: The task.*|BMC back after \" .detail \"\"}}{{else if eq .step \"rollback\" \"done\"}} · {{.detail}}{{end}}{{end}}{{if and .reasons_text (ne .reasons_text \"[]\")}} · {{.reasons_text}}{{end}}" | label_format step=`{{if eq .step "pre-flight"}}1 pre-flight{{else if eq .step "drain"}}2 drain{{else if eq .step "update"}}3 update{{else if eq .step "reset"}}4 reset{{else if eq .step "post-check"}}5 post-check{{else if eq .step "rollback"}}5 rollback{{else if eq .step "rollback update"}}5 rollback · update{{else if eq .step "rollback reset"}}5 rollback · reset{{else if eq .step "rollback post-check"}}5 rollback · post-check{{else if eq .step "undrain"}}6 undrain{{else if eq .step "soak"}}after the wave · soak{{else if eq .step "done"}}end · outcome{{else}}{{.step}}{{end}}`

value.title: Its every event in this run

panels.title: Checks and recovery: hosts per step and outcome
panels.description: How many hosts each step passed or failed, in the order a host goes through them: 1 pre-flight again on a fresh read, 2 drain, 3 update, 4 reset, 5 post-check and, when it fails, the rollback, 6 undrain; then the soak after the wave, and how each host ended

targets.expr: sum by (step, state) (count_over_time({job="rollout",site="$site"} | json | pipeline="$pipeline" | host!="-" | state!="start" | state!="task" | step=~"pre-flight|drain|update|reset|post-check|soak|rollback.*|undrain|done" | label_format step=`{{if eq .step "pre-flight"}}1 pre-flight{{else if eq .step "drain"}}2 drain{{else if eq .step "update"}}3 update{{else if eq .step "reset"}}4 reset{{else if eq .step "post-check"}}5 post-check{{else if eq .step "rollback"}}5 rollback{{else if eq .step "rollback update"}}5 rollback · update{{else if eq .step "rollback reset"}}5 rollback · reset{{else if eq .step "rollback post-check"}}5 rollback · post-check{{else if eq .step "undrain"}}6 undrain{{else if eq .step "soak"}}after the wave · soak{{else if eq .step "done"}}end · outcome{{else}}{{.step}}{{end}}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Decision log
panels.description: The plan saved, each stage's start and end, each gate, and how each host ended, newest first

targets.expr: {job="rollout",site="$site"} | json | pipeline="$pipeline" | step=~"run|gate|done" or (step="plan" and host="-") | line_format "{{.stage}} · {{.step}} {{.state}}{{if .wave}} · {{.wave}}{{end}}{{if ne .host \"-\"}} · {{.host}}{{end}}{{if .detail}} · {{.detail}}{{end}}"
